highlights:
Seasonal high-top silhouette: A raised collar and plush lining give this lace-up shoe a clear cold-season casual appearance.

Adjustable lace front: Metal-look eyelets and a raised tongue define the instep fastening across both colour options.

Apron toe stitching: A curved seam outlines the forefoot above the continuous wraparound sole sidewall.

Visible entry details: Original close photographs show the plush collar texture and rear pull loop for handling the shoe when putting it on.

Two colour directions: Black offers a tonal profile, while Khaki pairs a tan upper with light-coloured lining. Both are listed in EU39-46 for wholesale colour-size assortments.
